transcript: I sent a locked bottle of whiskey to a $10 million business along with a question. Have you got any old leads sitting in your database? I can turn into sales using AI. You only pay me when you get a result. It's not gonna cost you a penny otherwise. Of course they said yes. Obviously they do. And when you know how to make offers like this, landing clients is super easy. And this is how I generated $1.2 million for a single business, and they've sent me over $225,000 as a thank you. A simple AI bot talks to old leads, handles the objection, books the calls, follow-ups like a pro, and it's 100% automated. I haven't worked a lead, done a cold call, or built a funnel in a very long time. And now I can sit back and watch AI reactivate old leads while I sit back and get a cut of the profits for doing nothing. Follow me for more.
